comments.author: @coastuncle1965
comments.text: Schools issue a 300 day schedule day one... day two and the issued schedule is "modified". Half day here... teachers work day there... next thing parents know their child has a 90 day school year. No one has ever checked out how many days kids really go to school. They never review what the schedule really was.I'm exaggerating of course but WOW. Check the test scores in Quepos. No one will ever check because they don't want to know.
